p: “The wife of the dead man shall not be married outside of the family to one not of his kin; … She who sits outside, … she shall not be married to one not of his kin,

“The wife of the dead man shall not be married outside of the family to one not of his kin; her brother-in-law will have intercourse with her and take her to him to be his wife, and consummate the levirate marriage” (Deuteronomy 25:5). They understood the word “outside” to be a description of the woman: She who sits outside, i.e., one who is only betrothed; she shall not be married to one not of his kin,
But she who is not sitting outside, … shall marry one not of his kin.
But she who is not sitting outside, but who has already married, shall marry one not of his kin.
